title: Product safety recall: Sun Harbour Kitchen non-stick pans
text: UK trading standards announced a recall of 28 cm non-stick frying pans made by Sun Harbour Kitchen of Ningbo, after tests found coating flaking at normal cooking temperatures. The recall is open; the company says a fix is being tested and no end date is set.

title: Lumen Housewares recalls electric kettles in the United States
text: Lumen Housewares, a small-appliance brand based in Columbus, Ohio, recalled 40,000 electric kettles after reports of faulty thermostats. The recall is open. Lumen Housewares is not connected to any European cookware company of a similar name.

title: Ganges Steel Craft closes knife-handle recall
text: Ganges Steel Craft of Moradabad said its recall of a batch of chef's knives with loose handles, opened in March 2025, is now closed. Regulators confirmed the corrective action. The company changed its rivet supplier.

title: Ethical audit suspended at Bosphorus Housewares
text: An independent auditor suspended the ethical trade certificate of Bosphorus Housewares, Istanbul, after finding excessive overtime at its stamping plant. The suspension stays in place until a re-audit, not expected before 2027.

title: Port congestion eases at Yantian
text: Container waiting times at Yantian fell to under two days in June, according to port authority data.

title: Kestrel Steelworks wins regional manufacturing award
text: The Sheffield cutlery and cookware maker Kestrel Steelworks won a regional award for apprenticeship training.

title: Typhoon season disrupts Kaohsiung sailings
text: Two sailings from Kaohsiung were delayed by up to five days during September storms. Carriers expect normal schedules in October.

title: Atlas Kitchen Trading opens UK warehouse
text: Atlas Kitchen Trading of Valencia opened a bonded warehouse in Northampton and now quotes delivered-duty-paid prices to UK retailers. The company sources part of its range from contract factories in Spain and Portugal.

title: Rupee weakens against sterling
text: The Indian rupee fell about 3% against sterling in the first quarter, making Indian exports cheaper for UK buyers.

title: Duro Cookware expands enamel line
text: Duro Cookware of Porto added a second enamel furnace and says lead times will stay at about two weeks.

title: Golden Wok Industrial raises minimum orders
text: Golden Wok Industrial told distributors that its minimum order will rise to 2,000 units per product line from January.

title: Hanil Kitchen adds production shift
text: Hanil Kitchen of Busan added a night shift but still quotes five weeks of production time for new export customers.

title: Sun Harbour Kitchen wins design prize
text: A Sun Harbour Kitchen mixing bowl set won a packaging design prize at a Shanghai trade fair.

title: Vistula Enamel: single furnace maintenance
text: Vistula Enamel will shut its only enamel furnace for two weeks of maintenance in February 2027.

title: Steel prices stable in Europe
text: European flat steel prices were broadly stable in the second quarter, according to an industry survey.

title: Anatolia Metal opens second plant
text: Anatolia Metal of Izmir opened a second pressing plant, which the company says will cut lead times.
